■ Stage Direction
Linger: Nuance of reminiscing about taking 1st place in a race

But I just don't know what to do! When I think about failing
to run right again, I'm just like, totally done with racing!
Racing... Racing is... something I love.
I wanna... win...!
...Though, why is that, I wonder?

Her previously tense expression had vanished before I knew it,
replaced by a feisty, defiant grin.

...Right after enrollment, I got hurt and had to take time off—
and by the time I came back, everyone had left me in the dust.

Fearing defeat so desperately that one becomes paralyzed by it—
very few Umamusume possess such an intense obsession with victory.

For instance, in a fierce neck-and-neck battle right before the wire,
the one who seizes victory in the end is the one with the greater hunger to win.

—Still, I just don't wanna lose.
Losing sucks, and looking like a total loser sucks even more...!

I mean, everyone's gotten super strong already,
plus, y'know, my hooves are weak, so if I get hurt again—

...Man, you really are weird.
I'm not even your trainee, so how can you say all that so confidently?

Well... my parents are straight-laced health freaks, y'know?
I could never eat stuff like this as a kid, so now I'm kinda making up for it, I guess?

A slight setback can easily be overcome with training. As for her hooves,
we just need to design a regimen around their weakness. I made sure to convey that firmly.
That's why, when it comes to racing... In a race, of all places—

And so, right now, I'm just...
kinda, like... totally out of motivation, y'know?
...Huh?
Really...?
......You're weird.

*munch*... *munch*... *munch*... *munch*...
*munch*... *munch*... *munch*... *munch*...
If I lose any more, I won't have anything left at all!

Extreme fear can sometimes cause oxygen deprivation or anemia. That was
likely the reason she couldn't run properly during the mock races.

Toosen Jordan certainly looked unmotivated at first glance.
However, watching her actions closely—
I felt as if I had finally uncovered her true feelings.
...My hooves, y'know? They're weak. That's just how I am.
Eh?

I wanna win! I really wanna win, win, win, win like crazy,
and feel like 'Hell yeah, I'm amazing, I'm the absolute best' out there again—!

I'll wait for the next chance.
With that in mind, as I quietly watched her leave—

Anyway, you're a Trainer, so I figured you'd stop me.
Look at this, I'm taking in an insane amount of calories right now. You cool with that?

I ran like I didn't care at all, y'know?
Everyone else says so too. So—

...Y-Yeah. That was my plan.
But, I mean... it's not like what I think can even be trusted.

The gap is insane. The gap between me and my classmates. I lost and lost and lost so much,
it felt like I racked up a lifetime's worth of losses.

Yet everyone else is working hard, and that just made me hate school too!
I know acting like this won't help me win next time either, but still—

...No, but, like... I-I mean!
Even if I try, if I can't run properly when it counts—

...Being in first place feels so damn good, y'know? That's the only time
everyone looks at me like I'm something truly incredible.

...I've always sucked at school. I'm clumsy with my hands, and I get into fights
all the time. I've got nothing going for me, I'm a real screw-up.

...I mean, during that mock race the other day, I tried to run,
but for some reason I just totally couldn't...

I... I had nothing else besides racing...!
And yet, I can't win at all anymore—

Toosen Jordan quickly took off after finishing her meal.
I hesitated on whether to stop her, but I didn't want to force a conversation.
Somehow... I'm feeling like I might actually win.

...You get scared, right? Then you run. Then you get hurt again, right?
Then you rest, and fall behind even more... It's just a never-ending cycle!

Having brought Toosen Jordan to a fast food joint,
she inhaled the hamburgers almost like they were drinks.

If only... If only you............
were strong enough—screw this. Seriously.
I just really wanted to win, no matter what.

*pant, pant*...! 2 more—no, 4 more laps!
Not yet, not yet...! —Ouch!!

Even as she grumbled, the meticulous care she put into massaging them
did not look like the behavior of someone lacking motivation.
Out on the track... I feel like maybe I can actually do something, y'know?
Phew... Thanks for the food. See ya.
*sigh*... Aren't you weird? You're totally throwing off my rhythm, seriously.
